title: Can You Pass This Blind Spot Quiz?
hook: Can you spot this blind spot?

script.narration: Can you spot this blind spot?
script.visual_search: driver adjusting side mirror from inside car

script.narration: Most drivers adjust their mirrors so they can see the side of their own car. But that creates a massive hidden danger zone. Pause and guess the correct fix.
script.visual_search: car side mirror reflecting adjacent lane traffic

script.narration: You should angle them outward until you can't see your car at all. Like if this helped, follow for daily driving tips. Did you guess right? Comment yes or no, because
script.visual_search: driver checking blind spot looking over shoulder

description: Test your knowledge with a quick driving quiz. Learn the correct way to adjust your side mirrors to eliminate dangerous blind spots and protect yourself on the road.
why_it_will_work: Mini-quiz formats naturally boost engagement and retention by prompting viewers to pause, answer, and watch the full loop.
